in_sanskrit.name: शरोवन
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: शरो वन् (sharo van) - Shara (Shining) + Van (Forest). This name refers to someone who is radiant and glowing like a forest full of blooming flowers.

in_hindi.name: शरोवन
in_hindi.long_meaning: The name Sharovan in Hindi translates to 'something that is radiant and embellishes the body'. This name is derived from the words 'sharo' (shining) and 'van' (forest), which together evoke the image of a radiant forest full of blooming flowers.

in_tamil.name: சரவன
in_tamil.long_meaning: The Tamil name Sharovan translates to 'something that is adorned with beauty'. The name is derived from the words 'charithu' (adorned) and 'van' (forest), which together suggest a beautiful forest filled with adornments.

in_telugu.name: శరోవన
in_telugu.long_meaning: The Telugu name Sharovan translates to 'something that adorns the body'. The name is derived from the words 'sharīrya' (body) and 'bhūśaṇ' (adornment), which together suggest someone who is adorned and beautiful.

in_marathi.name: Sharovan
in_marathi.long_meaning: Sharovan हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। The name Sharovan is derived from the Sanskrit words 'Shara' meaning 'chariot' and 'Van' meaning 'forest'.
